subject.title: [Bug]: Docker Install + Sandbox can't workspaceAccess at all

question: Should OpenClaw add a validated host-path remapping contract for Docker Gateway/DooD managed sandbox mounts, or keep identical host/container paths as the supported contract?
rationale: The choice changes sandbox bind-source trust boundaries, operator setup compatibility, and whether the fix needs config/schema/doctor support, so automation should not choose it without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
options.body: Add or sponsor a validated mapping path for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with schema/docs/doctor coverage and live DooD proof.

options.title: Keep Identical-Path Contract
options.body: Document and enforce that Docker Gateway deployments must mount the same host path inside the Gateway container, with doctor/setup warnings for mismatched deployments.

options.title: Land Only Narrow Skill Repair
options.body: Treat the open materialized-skills PR as a partial fix while keeping this canonical issue open for the broader workspaceAccess contract.

recommendation.title: Define Secure Remapping Contract
recommendation.body: Add or sponsor a validated mapping path for managed workspace, agent workspace, materialized skill, and browser mounts, with schema/docs/doctor coverage and live DooD proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They already marked this issue canonical and have recent Docker/sandbox work relevant to the boundary decision.
